stepsBeforeSave.where: android-release.yml: release-android: Show release parameters

step.name: Show release parameters
step.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Re-dispatching needs the branch, but reproducing a specific red run
# needs the commit: the branch will have moved on by then.
echo "app version:    ${APP_VERSION}"
echo "versionCode:    ${ANDROID_VERSION_CODE}"
echo "track:          ${RELEASE_TRACK}"
echo "branch:         ${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
echo "commit:         ${GITHUB_SHA}"
echo "clear cache:    ${CLEAR_CACHE}"
echo "expo dep check: ${VALIDATE_EXPO_DEPENDENCIES}"
echo "message:        ${BUILD_MESSAGE:-<none>}"
echo "platform only:  ${PLATFORM_ONLY_REASON:-<no, iOS mirrors this version>}"
echo "triggered by:   ${GITHUB_ACTOR}"

RERUN_COMMAND=$(printf 'gh workflow run android-release.yml --repo %s --ref %s -f app_version=%s -f android_version_code=%s -f track=%s -f clear_cache=%s -f validate_expo_dependencies=%s' \
  "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" "${APP_VERSION}" "${ANDROID_VERSION_CODE}" \
  "${RELEASE_TRACK}" "${CLEAR_CACHE}" "${VALIDATE_EXPO_DEPENDENCIES}")
if [ -n "${BUILD_MESSAGE}" ]; then
  RERUN_COMMAND="${RERUN_COMMAND} -f message=$(printf '%q' "${BUILD_MESSAGE}")"
fi
if [ -n "${PLATFORM_ONLY_REASON}" ]; then
  RERUN_COMMAND="${RERUN_COMMAND} -f platform_only_reason=$(printf '%q' "${PLATFORM_ONLY_REASON}")"
fi

echo "re-run:         ${RERUN_COMMAND}"

{
  echo "### Release parameters"
  echo
  echo "| Parameter | Value |"
  echo "| --- | --- |"
  echo "| App version | \`${APP_VERSION}\` |"
  echo "| versionCode | \`${ANDROID_VERSION_CODE}\` |"
  echo "| Track | \`${RELEASE_TRACK}\` |"
  echo "| Branch | \`${GITHUB_REF_NAME}\` |"
  echo "| Commit | \`${GITHUB_SHA}\` |"
  echo "| Clear cache | \`${CLEAR_CACHE}\` |"
  echo "| Expo dep check | \`${VALIDATE_EXPO_DEPENDENCIES}\` |"
  echo "| Platform only reason | ${PLATFORM_ONLY_REASON:-none, iOS mirrors this version} |"
  echo "| Triggered by | \`${GITHUB_ACTOR}\` |"
  echo
  echo "Re-run this release with the same values:"
  echo
  echo '```bash'
  echo "${RERUN_COMMAND}"
  echo '```'
} >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

stepsBeforeSave.where: android-release.yml: release-android: Keep only the objects that this build used

step.name: Keep only the objects that this build used
step.run:
set -euo pipefail
ccache --dir ~/.cache/ccache --evict-older-than "$(($(date +%s) - COMPILER_CACHE_USED_SINCE))s"
cd ~/.cache/ccache
directory='^[0-9a-f](/[0-9a-f]){0,3}$'
file='^[0-9a-f]/(CACHEDIR\.TAG|stats|[0-9a-f]/stats|[0-9a-f](/[0-9a-f]){0,2}/([0-9a-v]{29,31}([MR]|[0-9]W)|[0-9a-f]{36,38}(_[0-9a-f]{2})?))$'
find . -mindepth 1 -depth -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do
  layout=$file
  if [[ -d $entry ]]; then layout=$directory; fi
  if [[ -L $entry || ! ( -d $entry || -f $entry ) || ! ${entry#./} =~ $layout ]]; then rm -rf "$entry"; fi
done

step.run:
set -euo pipefail

  if [ -z "${!key}" ]; then echo "::error::Missing $key"; exit 1; fi

# WHY: Tauri's bundle_dmg.sh runs hdiutil create once, and hosted runners can report "Resource busy";
# retry as create-dmg/create-dmg#198 does (5 retries, doubling waits). Upstream report: create-dmg/create-dmg#143.
log="$RUNNER_TEMP/macos-bundle.log"
retries=0
until npm run "bundle:${DESKTOP_VARIANT}" -- --config release-config.json \
  --config "$ORBIT_MACOS_SIGNING/signing-config.json" --target "$DESKTOP_TARGET" --bundles app,dmg --ci 2>&1 | tee "$log"; do
  if [ "$retries" -ge 5 ] || ! grep -q 'bundle_dmg.sh: .*Resource busy' "$log"; then exit 1; fi

  echo "::warning::bundle_dmg.sh reported hdiutil busy; retry $retries of 5"

step.name: Clean the ccache directory before its save
step.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ $COMPILE_OUTCOME == success ]]; then
  ccache --dir ${{ env.CCACHE_DIR }} --evict-older-than "$(($(date +%s) - COMPILER_CACHE_USED_SINCE))s"
fi
cd ${{ env.CCACHE_DIR }}
directory='^[0-9a-f](/[0-9a-f]){0,3}$'
file='^[0-9a-f]/(CACHEDIR\.TAG|stats|[0-9a-f]/stats|[0-9a-f](/[0-9a-f]){0,2}/([0-9a-v]{29,31}([MR]|[0-9]W)|[0-9a-f]{36,38}(_[0-9a-f]{2})?))$'
find . -mindepth 1 -depth -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' entry; do
  layout=$file
  if [[ -d $entry ]]; then layout=$directory; fi
  if [[ -L $entry || ! ( -d $entry || -f $entry ) || ! ${entry#./} =~ $layout ]]; then rm -rf "$entry"; fi
done

step.name: Hash the test tasks and read the changed paths
step.run:
set -euo pipefail
node .github/scripts/write-locked-package.mjs turbo "$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo"
npm ci --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
"$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo/node_modules/.bin/turbo" run test --dry=json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo-test.json"
if [ "$EVENT_NAME" = pull_request ]; then git diff --name-only --no-renames HEAD^1 HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/changed-paths.txt"; fi
node .github/scripts/plan-test-jobs.mjs --event "$EVENT_NAME" --turbo-dry "$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo-test.json" \
  --workflow .github/workflows/test.yml --changed-files "$RUNNER_TEMP/changed-paths.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
